channel.title: Food Recall Digest
channel.description: Check your kitchen. Every US food recall, fact-checked against the official notice.

item.title: Haifa Smoked Fish cold smoked sprats recall: Possible botulism (Clostridium botulinum)
item.description: Possible botulism (Clostridium botulinum). Stores, seafood counters and restaurants in CT, NJ, NY, PA. Do this: Don't eat them.

item.title: Imperio beef jerky (carne seca), 2 oz recall: Not inspected, misused USDA mark
item.description: Not inspected, misused USDA mark. Stores in 7 states. Do this: Don't eat them.

item.title: Ultimate Forza male supplement capsules recall: Undeclared sildenafil, tadalafil and dapoxetine
item.description: Undeclared sildenafil, tadalafil and dapoxetine. Some GNC franchise stores in the US. Do this: Stop using it.

item.title: Natural Grocers organic mung beans, 2 lb recall: Possible glass pieces
item.description: Possible glass pieces. Natural Grocers stores in 22 states. Do this: Don't eat them.

item.title: WinCo Foods hoagie rolls, 16 oz recall: Undeclared sesame
item.description: Undeclared sesame. WinCo stores in 7 states. Do this: If you're allergic to sesame, don't eat them.

item.title: Kayem, al fresco and McKenzie ready-to-eat meats recall: Possible temperature abuse
item.description: Possible temperature abuse. Stores and food service nationwide. Do this: Don't eat them.

item.title: Gelatelli Coffee & Vanilla Gelato, 16 fl oz (Lidl) recall: Listeria
item.description: Listeria. Lidl stores in 9 states and DC. Do this: Don't eat it.

item.title: Starfish Seafood sliced cold smoked salmon, 8 oz recall: Listeria
item.description: Listeria. NY, FL, GA, NJ, PA, OH. Do this: Don't eat it.

item.description: E. coli O26:H11 and O45:H2. Grocers in NY, PA, NJ, CT, MD, VA, MA. Do this: Don't eat it.

item.description: Undeclared sesame. Puerto Rico. Do this: If you’re allergic to sesame, don’t eat it.

item.description: Undeclared sesame. CT, MA. Do this: If you’re allergic to sesame, don’t eat it.

item.title: Eden Brothers Calabrese broccoli seeds recall: Salmonella
item.description: Salmonella. Sold online nationwide. Do this: Don't plant, sprout, eat or share the seeds, and don't use them for microgreens.

item.title: Gardeners Basics broccoli sprouting seeds, 1 lb recall: Salmonella
item.description: Salmonella. Sold online nationwide. Do this: Stop using the seeds.

item.description: Undeclared alcohols (ethanol, methanol, isopropanol). Sold online. Do this: Stop using any bottle from lot 25122bw.

item.title: RAPTURE Preworkout powder, lot 260327-4 recall: Contains DMAA (heart risk)
item.description: Contains DMAA (heart risk). Nationwide, stores and online. Do this: Stop using it.

item.title: GRACE chicken Vienna sausages, 140 g cans recall: Illegally imported from Jamaica (not eligible)
item.description: Illegally imported from Jamaica (not eligible). AL, FL, GA, MD, TX. Do this: Don't eat them.

item.title: Nature’s Own Hawaiian Bread, 20 oz & 40 oz recall: Undeclared milk
item.description: Undeclared milk. AR, LA, NM, OK, TX. Do this: If you’re allergic to milk, don’t eat it if the best-by date, UPC or product code matches.

item.title: Saint Francis frozen pizzas, Cincinnati area recall: Undeclared soy
item.description: Undeclared soy. 11 shops in OH & KY + cincyfavorites.com. Do this: If you’re allergic to soy, don’t eat it.

item.description: Made with recalled Mezzetta peperoncini (possible pest). WinCo, 8 states. Do this: Don’t eat any leftover tray with these dates.

item.description: Toxic plant (yellow oleander). Do this: Stop taking now.

item.description: Imported without USDA reinspection. Do this: Don’t eat it.

item.title: Mezzetta Golden Greek peperoncini recall: Possible pest in jar
item.description: Possible pest in jar. One lot only. Do this: Don’t eat it if you have this lot.

item.description: Undeclared lobster. Massachusetts. Do this: If you’re allergic to shellfish, don’t eat it.
